Bot vs bot: average score for the row bot against the column bot

Completed games retain finish-order scoring: winner first, then later elimination turn. In time- or turn-limited games, an eliminated row bot loses (0); only a row bot still owning territories ties (0.5). Opposite directions therefore need not add to 100%. n counts completed, time-limited and turn-limited games; errors and watchdogs without valid results are excluded. Cell tooltips include an approximate 95% Jeffreys-prior credible interval for average score (normal approximation). Hover over a player for overall wins, losses, ties and stopping reasons. Cells with n<MINN are faded. Source: deduplicated master_results.sgl; pre-stalemate Doomstack results are labeled challenger; pre-2026-10-23 Actuary games are excluded. Valid pre-safety-fix games are pooled with the same strategy; legacy strategy versions remain separate. Pre-restoration Brainless V results are pooled with V; the VI route-planner strategy boundary remains separate. The validated 2026-11-09 fixed-budget representative study was imported on 2026-11-12; this pooled matrix is not its standalone win-rate ranking.
Recorded-seed recovery overlay: 1128 completed reruns replace their original timeout outcomes, without counting either game twice. Unresolved parallel timeouts retain their historical outcomes. Raw historical records are unchanged; recovered seeds do not establish that all original rules and bot versions were identical.
  Ties included as half a point; percentages are scores, not outright win percentages.
